description: We are team Stellar4, consisting of students from Aselsan Vocational and Technical Anatolian High School.
summary: Stellar4's "Journey to Space" project transforms complex NASA data into an interactive science book for students and teachers. Created by İklim Tuana Peksoy and Aykız Zeynep Çiçekli, it replaces passive reading with a branching narrative where young readers actively explore real missions to the Moon and Mars using authentic NASA datasets like ALSEP, SuperCam, and Ingenuity.
details:
Here are the detailed aspects of the project based on the documentation:

Problem Statement: NASA's rich scientific data often remains complex and difficult for children to access due to heavy technical language.

Core Objective:To eliminate passive reading habits and transform space science into an accessible, understandable, and curiosity-inspiring experience for young learners.

Target Audience: Primary and middle school students, teachers, and science enthusiasts.

Project Team: Developed by İklim Tuana Peksoy and Aykız Zeynep Çiçekli under the team name Stellar4.

Solution & System Design: Moving away from classic science books, the project utilizes an interactive branching narrative and smart data mapping algorithm. Readers actively make decisions that shape the story's flow, such as choosing routes and inspecting devices. For example, readers can choose to glide toward the Moon's craters to examine Apollo modules or launch toward Mars to explore robotic rovers.

Characters and Narrative Elements: The story features student characters named Kaan and Gökçe alongside their custom-designed mini-robot, Atak. The digital interactive book format includes button-operated controls, custom visualizations, and dynamic event triggers (such as energy flow warnings).

Integration of Real Space Data: The project bridges imagination with authentic science by incorporating real NASA datasets—including ALSEP, SuperCam, and Ingenuity—into the narrative framework.

Value and Applicability: By blending real data with interactive storytelling, the project enhances ease of learning and serves as an innovative, transferable educational tool that can be integrated into school curricula as modern science course material.
